Tata Motors' Iveco Takeover Offer Approved by Italian Regulator

Italy's market regulator, Consob, has approved Tata Motors' tender offer to acquire common shares of Iveco Group. The offer is being made by TML CV Holdings B.V., an indirect wholly-owned step-down subsidiary of Tata Motors. The voluntary offer will open on September 7, 2026, and close on October 26, 2026, unless extended. Iveco shareholders will be offered €14.10 per common share, including a dividend. This approval marks a significant step in the proposed takeover.
